001package org.clafer.scope;
002
003import java.math.BigDecimal;
004import java.math.BigInteger;
005import java.math.RoundingMode;
006import java.util.Collections;
007import java.util.HashMap;
008import java.util.Map;
009import java.util.Map.Entry;
010import java.util.Set;
011import org.clafer.ast.AstClafer;
012import org.clafer.common.Check;
013
014/**
015 * <p>
016 * An immutable mapping from Clafers to their scope. Also contains the scope of
017 * integers for solving, like the bit-width in Alloy, but more flexible because
018 * the lowest and highest integers can be set independently and does not have to
019 * be a power of 2.
020 * </p>
021 * <p>
022 * The scope is built through the constructor or {@link ScopeBuilder}, whichever
023 * is more convenient.
024 * </p>
025 * <p>
026 * Example 1:
027 * <pre>
028 * Map&lt;AstClafer, Integer&gt; map = new HashMap&lt;&gt();
029 * map.put(claferA, 3);
030 * map.put(claferB, 2);
031 * Scope scope = new Scope(map, 3, -16, 16, null, null, 10, (char) 0x20, (char) 0x7e);
032 * </pre>
033 * </p>
034 * <p>
035 * Example 2:
036 * <pre>
037 * Scope scope = Scope.setScope(claferA, 3).setScope(claferB, 2).defaultScope(3).intLow(-16).intHigh(16).toScope();
038 * </pre>
039 * </p>
040 * <p>
041 * Both examples construct the same scope.
042 * </p>
043 *
044 * <p>
045 * What is scope? Because of the expressiveness of Clafer, reasoning is too
046 * difficult in general. The scope is a limitation of the solver so that
047 * reasoning is feasible.
048 * <p>
049 * Example 1:
050 * <pre>
051 * A : int
052 * B : int
053 * C : int
054 * [A * A * A + B * B * B = C * C * C]
055 * </pre>
056 * </p>
057 * <p>
058 * Example 2:
059 * <pre>
060 * A 2..*
061 * B 2..*
062 * C 2..*
063 * [#A * #A * #A + #B * #B * #B = #C * #C * #C]
064 * </pre>
065 * </p>
066 * Both examples are attempting to prove/disprove Fermat's last theorem for k=3,
067 * although this easily generalizes for any k. Unfortunately this is too
068 * difficult, so the solver only attempts to prove/disprove upto a certain
069 * scope. In example 1, a scope of {@code Scope.intLow(2).intHigh(16).toScope()}
070 * would only attempt the proof for integers between 2 and 16. In example 2, a
071 * scope of {@code Scope.defaultScope(16).toScope()} would also only attempt the
072 * proof for integers between 2 and 16 (the example uses encodes integers using
073 * cardinality).
074 *
075 * @author jimmy
076 * @see ScopeBuilder
077 */
078public class Scope implements Scopable {
079
080    /**
081     * The largest decimal scale (number of fractional digits).
082     */
083    public static final int MaxDecimalScale = 9;
084    /**
085     * The largest magnitude of a scaled decimal: one below Choco's bound for
086     * integer variables ({@code IntVar.MAX_INT_BOUND = Integer.MAX_VALUE / 100}),
087     * which leaves a value for the uninitialized reference.
088     */
089    public static final int MaxScaledDecimal = Integer.MAX_VALUE / 100 - 1;
090
091    private final Map<AstClafer, Integer> scopes;
092    private final int defaultScope;
093    private final int intLow, intHigh;
094    private final Integer mulLow, mulHigh;
095    private final int stringLength;
096    private final char charLow, charHigh;
097    private final int decimalScale;
098    private final int decimalLow, decimalHigh;
099    // The decimal range as given, null for the largest that fits.
100    private final BigDecimal decimalLowBound, decimalHighBound;
101
102    /**
103     * Construct a new scope without decimals. Altering the map has no affect
104     * once the scope is constructed.
105     *
106     * @param scopes a map of Clafers to their scopes
107     * @param defaultScope the scope for unspecified Clafers
108     * @param intLow the lowest (inclusive) integer used for solving
109     * @param intHigh the highest (inclusive) integer used for solving
110     * @param mulLow the lowest (inclusive) integer used for solving
111     * multiplication or null to use {@code intLow}
112     * @param mulHigh the highest (inclusive) integer used for solving
113     * multiplication or null to use {@code intHigh}
114     * @param stringLength the longest (inclusive) string used for solving
115     * @param charLow the lowest (inclusive) character used for solving
116     * @param charHigh the highest (inclusive) character used for solving
117     */
118    public Scope(Map<AstClafer, Integer> scopes, int defaultScope, int intLow, int intHigh,
119            Integer mulLow, Integer mulHigh, int stringLength, char charLow, char charHigh) {
120        this(scopes, defaultScope, intLow, intHigh, mulLow, mulHigh, stringLength, charLow, charHigh,
121                0, null, null);
122    }
123
124    /**
125     * Construct a new scope. Altering the map has no affect once the scope is
126     * constructed.
127     *
128     * @param scopes a map of Clafers to their scopes
129     * @param defaultScope the scope for unspecified Clafers
130     * @param intLow the lowest (inclusive) integer used for solving
131     * @param intHigh the highest (inclusive) integer used for solving
132     * @param mulLow the lowest (inclusive) integer used for solving
133     * multiplication or null to use {@code intLow}
134     * @param mulHigh the highest (inclusive) integer used for solving
135     * multiplication or null to use {@code intHigh}
136     * @param stringLength the longest (inclusive) string used for solving
137     * @param charLow the lowest (inclusive) character used for solving
138     * @param charHigh the highest (inclusive) character used for solving
139     * @param decimalScale the number of fractional digits of decimals
140     * @param decimalLow the lowest (inclusive) decimal used for solving, or
141     * null for the lowest that fits
142     * @param decimalHigh the highest (inclusive) decimal used for solving, or
143     * null for the highest that fits
144     */
145    public Scope(Map<AstClafer, Integer> scopes, int defaultScope, int intLow, int intHigh,
146            Integer mulLow, Integer mulHigh, int stringLength, char charLow, char charHigh,
147            int decimalScale, BigDecimal decimalLow, BigDecimal decimalHigh) {
148        if (defaultScope <= 0) {
149            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Default scope must be positive");
150        }
151        for (Entry<AstClafer, Integer> entry : scopes.entrySet()) {
152            if (entry.getValue() < 0) {
153                throw new IllegalArgumentException(entry.getKey().getName() + " scope set to " + entry.getValue() + ". Scope must be non-negative.");
154            }
155        }
156        if (intLow > intHigh) {
157            throw new IllegalArgumentException("intLow(" + intLow + ") > intHigh(" + intHigh + ")");
158        }
159        if ((mulLow == null ? intLow : mulLow) > (mulHigh == null ? intHigh : mulHigh)) {
160            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
161                    "mulLow(" + (mulLow == null ? intLow : mulLow) + ") > mulHigh(" + (mulHigh == null ? intHigh : mulHigh) + ")");
162        }
163        if (stringLength < 0) {
164            throw new IllegalArgumentException("stringLength cannot be negative");
165        }
166        if (charLow > charHigh) {
167            throw new IllegalArgumentException("charLow(" + charLow + ") > charHigh(" + charHigh + ")");
168        }
169        if (decimalScale < 0 || decimalScale > MaxDecimalScale) {
170            throw new IllegalArgumentException("decimalScale(" + decimalScale + ") must be between 0 and " + MaxDecimalScale);
171        }
172        this.decimalScale = decimalScale;
173        this.decimalLowBound = decimalLow;
174        this.decimalHighBound = decimalHigh;
175        this.decimalLow =decimalLow == null ? -MaxScaledDecimal : scaleDecimal(decimalLow, RoundingMode.CEILING);
176        this.decimalHigh = decimalHigh == null ? MaxScaledDecimal : scaleDecimal(decimalHigh, RoundingMode.FLOOR);
177        if (this.decimalLow > this.decimalHigh) {
178            throw new IllegalArgumentException("decimalLow(" + decimalLow + ") > decimalHigh(" + decimalHigh + ")");
179        }
180        this.scopes = new HashMap<>(scopes);
181        this.defaultScope = defaultScope;
182        this.intLow = intLow;
183        this.intHigh = intHigh;
184        this.mulLow = mulLow;
185        this.mulHigh = mulHigh;
186        this.stringLength = stringLength;
187        this.charLow = charLow;
188        this.charHigh = charHigh;
189    }
190
191    /**
192     * Returns the set of Clafers that have an explicit scope.
193     *
194     * @return the scoped Clafers
195     */
196    public Set<AstClafer> getScoped() {
197        return Collections.unmodifiableSet(scopes.keySet());
198    }
199
200    /**
201     * Returns the scope of the Clafer. If the Clafer is not specified a
202     * specific scope during the construction of this object, then the default
203     * scope is returned.
204     *
205     * @param clafer the Clafer
206     * @return the scope of the Clafer
207     */
208    public int getScope(AstClafer clafer) {
209        Integer scope = scopes.get(Check.notNull(clafer));
210        return scope == null ? defaultScope : scope;
211    }
212

214     * The scope for unspecified Clafers.
215     *
216     * @return the default scope
217     */
218    public int getDefaultScope() {
219        return defaultScope;
220    }

281    public char getCharHigh() {

285    /**
286     * Returns the number of fractional digits of decimals.
287     *
288     * @return the decimal scale
289     */
290    public int getDecimalScale() {
291        return decimalScale;
292    }
293
294    /**
295     * Returns {@code 10^decimalScale}, the integer that represents the decimal
296     * 1.
297     *
298     * @return the decimal one
299     */
300    public int getDecimalOne() {
301        int one = 1;
302        for (int i = 0; i < decimalScale; i++) {
303            one *= 10;
304        }
305        return one;
306    }
307
308    /**
309     * Returns the lowest (inclusive) decimal used for solving, scaled by
310     * {@link #getDecimalOne()}.
311     *
312     * @return the lowest scaled decimal
313     */
314    public int getDecimalLow() {
315        return decimalLow;
316    }
317
318    /**
319     * Returns the highest (inclusive) decimal used for solving, scaled by
320     * {@link #getDecimalOne()}.
321     *
322     * @return the highest scaled decimal
323     */
324    public int getDecimalHigh() {
325        return decimalHigh;
326    }
327
328    /**
329     * Scale a decimal to an integer at the decimal scale.
330     *
331     * @param value the decimal
332     * @param rounding how to round digits beyond the decimal scale
333     * @return the scaled decimal
334     * @throws IllegalArgumentException if the scaled decimal is out of the
335     * range Choco supports
336     * @throws ArithmeticException if rounding is
337     * {@link RoundingMode#UNNECESSARY} and the decimal has more fractional
338     * digits than the decimal scale
339     */
340    public int scaleDecimal(BigDecimal value, RoundingMode rounding) {
341        BigDecimal scaled = value.setScale(decimalScale, rounding);
342        if (scaled.unscaledValue().abs().compareTo(BigInteger.valueOf(MaxScaledDecimal)) > 0) {
343            throw new IllegalArgumentException(value.toPlainString() + " is out of the range of decimals with "
344                    + decimalScale + " fractional digits, "
345                    + unscaleDecimal(-MaxScaledDecimal).toPlainString() + ".."
346                    + unscaleDecimal(MaxScaledDecimal).toPlainString());
347        }
348        return scaled.unscaledValue().intValue();
349    }
350
351    /**
352     * The decimal an integer at the decimal scale represents.
353     *
354     * @param scaled the scaled decimal
355     * @return the decimal
356     */
357    public BigDecimal unscaleDecimal(int scaled) {
358        return BigDecimal.valueOf(scaled, decimalScale);
359    }

472    @Override
473    public Scope toScope() {
474        return this;
475    }
476
477    /**
478     * Construct the scope using the builder pattern. Use the current settings
479     * in this Scope as the defaults in the builder.
480     *
481     * @return a new builder
482     */
483    public ScopeBuilder toBuilder() {
484        return new ScopeBuilder(scopes, defaultScope, intLow, intHigh,
485                mulLow, mulHigh, stringLength, charLow, charHigh,
486                decimalScale, decimalLowBound, decimalHighBound);
487    }

489    /**
490     * A scope with the same settings but other Clafer scopes.
491     *
492     * @param scopes a map of Clafers to their scopes
493     * @return the new scope
494     */
495    public Scope withScopes(Map<AstClafer, Integer> scopes) {
496        return new Scope(scopes, defaultScope, intLow, intHigh,
497                mulLow, mulHigh, stringLength, charLow, charHigh,
498                decimalScale, decimalLowBound, decimalHighBound);
499    }
500
501    @Override
502    public String toString() {
503        StringBuilder result = new StringBuilder().append('{');
504        result.append("default:").append(defaultScope);
505        for (Entry<AstClafer, Integer> entry : scopes.entrySet()) {
506            result.append(", ").append(entry.getKey()).append(':').append(entry.getValue());
507        }
508        return result.append('}').toString();
509    }
